approval: Robert approved push and deployment of this map work on 2026-11-06 (decision 662).
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production game UI background, horizontal scroll map for Shattered Rifts, original dark fantasy.
Primary request: A hand-drawn cartographer's map on an ancient unrolled parchment scroll, viewed perfectly flat from overhead. Wide landscape 3:2 composition. The parchment fills the entire image; rolled lip of parchment at very top and very bottom, small frayed side edges, no desk, no props, no perspective. Warm muted antique ochre and bone paper, dark sepia pen and faded charcoal crosshatching. Extremely subtle violet mineral stains and tiny faded gilded ink details fit a dark fantasy world of shattered realms.
Subject: faint hand-inked mountain ridges, broken gothic ruins, small forests and fractured land contours sparsely distributed near upper and lower margins; a modest hand-drawn compass rose near lower right. Delicate thin contour drawings across the center at very low contrast, most of central 80 percent of sheet left open and light for interactive branching game nodes overlaid later. Rich convincing paper grain, folds, worn and slightly scorched edges, atmospheric painterly craftsmanship, elegant and ominous.
Constraints: This is a functional backdrop. Absolutely NO baked-in nodes, NO circles for markers, NO dotted routes, NO roads or paths, NO labels, NO writing, NO letters, NO numbers, NO title, NO UI, NO watermark. Landscape cartography stays faint so dark route lines and dark circular node markers will read clearly. Full rectangular parchment surface, no objects outside it, no transparency.
export: 1536×1024 JPEG, quality 90; original PNG preserved. Companion rift-cartographer-paper-v1.jpg is a 256×256 export of plain center paper at source x=600,y=340 for repeating texture; no repainting or retouching.
implementation: Nine-slice parchment follows the complete live route in both orientations. All 11 realm variants plus First Ruin and legacy rift select by saved StageMap.realm, with the approved generic fallback. Saved graphs and player ink coordinates preserved. Completed floors retain original icons with green checkmarks.
